floater.name: wolf_caves
floater.title: Cave Builder
floater.floater.string: Press New cave to make one, or pick a cave in the list and press Change.
The land impact shows here once the cave has a rock box, a tunnel and a doorway.
Working out the rock...
Ready: press Generate.
The generator made no rock for this cave - change the box, the tunnels or the doorways.
Pick a cave in the list first.
Choose the rock texture in the picker.
Draw the rock box first (step 1).
The rock box changed. Drag its handles to size, move or raise it, or go on to step 2.
The tunnel you were drawing was taken back.
There is nothing to undo.
Drag on the ground for a new box (a click makes 12 x 8 m). On the box: drag a corner or side to size it, inside to move it, the top handle to raise it. Esc stops.
Click points inside the rock box; double-click or Enter finishes the tunnel. Esc stops.
Press on a tunnel and drag outwards to size a cavern (height: the Cavern height slider). Esc stops.
Click where a tunnel meets the box wall: the rock opens there. Esc stops.
Draw the rock box
Change the box
Draw a tunnel
Add caverns
Add doorways
Stop drawing
Generate...
Generate again...
You moved to another region: the drawing was put away.
Drawn with the old Cave Builder (an open room): it cannot be changed - remove it and draw it again.
A cavern is a chamber on a tunnel - draw a tunnel first (step 2).
The tunnel you were drawing is kept. Working out the rock - Generate goes on by itself.
The ground will be dug out where the tunnels go.
Nothing on the ground is changed: the cave floor must be on or above the ground here.
You hold this region, so the ground under the tunnels can be dug out.
You own land here: the ground is dug out if the whole cave is on your land.
You don't own land here, so the cave must stay above the ground.
The Cave Builder only works on Wolf Territories, in a region the grid knows.
The pen cannot be picked up right now - try again in a moment.
A cave job is still running - wait for it to finish, or press Stop.
Stopping at the next safe point - a step already under way (making or rezzing the rock) finishes first.
Generating again needs the old rock in view, to take it away first. Stand nearer the cave and press Generate again.

button.name: cave_new
button.label: New cave
button.tool_tip: Start a new cave: draw its rock box on the ground

button.name: cave_edit
button.label: Change
button.tool_tip: Open the picked cave to change it and generate it again

button.name: cave_remove
button.label: Remove...
button.tool_tip: Take the picked cave away and put the ground back (asks first)

line_editor.name: cave_name
line_editor.tool_tip: The cave's name (also the rock object's name)

floater.text: Solid rock the cave is carved from. Drag on the ground to draw it; drag its handles to size, move (inside) or raise (top) it.

button.name: cave_pen_box
button.label: Draw the rock box
button.tool_tip: Put the pen down to draw the rock box or drag its handles (press again to stop)

spinner.label: Width
spinner.name: cave_box_w
spinner.tool_tip: Box width along its own x, metres (3 to 128)

spinner.label: Depth
spinner.name: cave_box_d
spinner.tool_tip: Box depth along its own y, metres (3 to 128)

spinner.label: Rock
spinner.name: cave_box_h
spinner.tool_tip: Rock height above the cave floor, metres (3 to 30): the top of the rocky hill

spinner.label: Turn
spinner.name: cave_box_turn
spinner.tool_tip: Turn of the box, degrees counter-clockwise from east

spinner.label: Floor height
spinner.name: cave_box_floor
spinner.tool_tip: Cave floor, region metres (every tunnel and cavern). Set to the ground height at the box centre when you draw the box.

floater.text: Click points inside the box; double-click or Enter finishes.

button.name: cave_pen_tunnel
button.label: Draw a tunnel
button.tool_tip: Put the pen down to draw a tunnel (press again to stop)

slider.label: Tunnel width
slider.name: cave_width
slider.tool_tip: Width of the next tunnel you draw, metres (2 to 40)

floater.text: Press on a tunnel and drag outwards to size a cavern.

button.name: cave_pen_cavern
button.label: Add caverns
button.tool_tip: Put the pen down to add caverns on the tunnels (press again to stop)

slider.label: Cavern height
slider.name: cave_cavern_h
slider.tool_tip: Height of the next cavern, metres (2.5 to 20); never taller than the rock box leaves room for under the rock above

floater.text: Click where a tunnel meets the box wall: the rock opens.

button.name: cave_pen_door
button.label: Add doorways
button.tool_tip: Put the pen down to add doorways (press again to stop)

combo_box.name: cave_rock
combo_box.tool_tip: The rock of the cave, inside and out

texture_picker.name: cave_rock_tex
texture_picker.tool_tip: The texture chosen for the rock (click to choose another)

slider.name: cave_roof
slider.tool_tip: Rock thickness over every ceiling, metres (0.5 to 6); the rock box must leave 2.5 m under it

combo_box.name: cave_light
combo_box.tool_tip: Stored as a Wolf Environment cave zone; shown once the Wolf Environment draws local zones

floater.text: The land impact shows here once the cave has a rock box, a tunnel and a doorway.
Press New cave to make one, or pick a cave in the list and press Change.

button.name: cave_back
button.label: Back to list
button.tool_tip: Put the drawing away and go back to the list

button.name: cave_undo
button.label: Undo last
button.tool_tip: Take back the last box change, tunnel, cavern or doorway

button.name: cave_cancel
button.label: Stop
button.tool_tip: Stop the running build or removal between two ground changes; what was done so far is kept in the cave's record so Generate again or Remove can finish it

button.name: cave_build
button.label: Generate...
button.tool_tip: Asks first: it rezzes the rock and digs the ground where you may change it
